bagPolicy.summary: One clear bag up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches or a one-gallon clear bag is permitted; also allowed are clear fanny packs up to 13 × 6 × 3 inches and clutches up to 4.5 × 6.5 inches. Large bags and backpacks are prohibited; paid lockers are available.
allowed: Clear fanny pack up to 13 × 6 × 3 inches
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Surrounding event lots do not allow overnight parking or tailgating. Use the venue directions for lot access and check the event listing for parking arrangements.

concessions.summary: Outside food and drinks are prohibited except a factory-sealed water bottle of 24 ounces or less, an empty plastic bottle, and small factory-sealed allergy-related food. Alcohol purchases are limited to two drinks per person per transaction.
allowed: Sealed water bottle up to 24 ounces
